name: Pokes climb Boop's mood one step at a time
case: Boop is calm when the person pokes it once, twice and three times in a row, a second apart. The first poke moves its mood one step, to curious or pleased, and it holds through the next two, a second apart, since a mood holds at least half a minute: never a move the mood graph doesn't have.
why: The one mood graph (2026-10-15): a mood moves one step along its pack's moves and holds at least 30 s (MoodPolicy), so pokes a second apart move it once. characters/boop/steering/mood/: a poke moves calm to curious or happy, two in a row to annoyed, three to irritated or grumpy (a jump a barrage earns); the mood question offers only the mood's moves
